name: Wizard
source: He is a wizard who lives in another dimension, and is the mastermind behind the "game." In order to both live and use his powers, he must take memories away from people as payment for granting their most desperate wish. After years of observing Heejung, he has developed an obsession with her. His real name is unknown. He is also responsible for bringing Eri's dolls to life.
